name: How long does a roof replacement readiness assessment take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a roof replacement readiness assessment take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical roof replacement readiness assessment can take anywhere from 30 minutes to a few hours, depending on the size, complexity, and accessibility of your roof. The process includes a thorough exterior inspection, attic inspection (if applicable), and a discussion of findings. Factors like multiple roof sections or difficult-to-reach areas can extend the assessment time. Our goal is to be efficient while ensuring a complete evaluation of your roofing system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Assessments usually take 30 minutes to a few hours, depending on roof size and complexity.
